# Pinball UI

> 29 ordinary UI controls as real pinball parts: photographed bodies (a lane, a shooter rod, flippers and a score reel, a drop-target bank, an outhole, pop bumpers), a chrome ball drawn live in WebGL that mirrors what is under it, and recorded sounds (solenoids, relays, chimes, a rolling ball). Each is one plain script that registers a custom element, with its photographs and sounds inside it: no dependencies, no build step, no other files to fetch. Licensed under the MIT License, Copyright (c) 2026 Brajesh Kumar. No real machine's names, art or logos are used.

Live gallery: https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui
Source: https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui

## Drop-in controls

Each is one plain script that registers a custom element. Load it with a script tag, not as a module. The original seven bundles include PinballKit, WebGL artwork and recorded sounds; the 22 utility bundles use a separate lightweight CSS/native helper and do not require WebGL or audio.

- [Toggle](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/toggle/toggle.js) (switch, about 848 KB): A switch whose knob is a chrome pinball in a short lane. Flip it and the ball is kicked across, hits the far wall, rocks in its seat and settles, and the lamp under the on end lights. `<pinball-toggle>`: Use <pinball-toggle></pinball-toggle>. Read el.checked and listen for change. Works in forms with a name, like a checkbox. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/toggle/README.md)
- [Slider](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/slider/slider.js) (slider, about 607 KB): A slider whose thumb is a chrome pinball rolling along a lane of ten lamps. Each lamp lights as the ball reaches it and goes out as the ball rolls back past it, so the lit lamps are the filled part of the track. `<pinball-slider>`: Use <pinball-slider value="40" min="0" max="100"></pinball-slider>. Read el.value; it fires input while it moves and change when let go. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/slider/README.md)
- [Plunger](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/plunger/plunger.js) (pull to send, about 432 KB): A send button you pull. It is a bare pinball shooter rod: knob, rod, spring and rubber tip. Pull the knob all the way back and a ball drops in front of the tip; let go and the plunger knocks the ball off the edge of the screen and fires send. `<pinball-plunger>`: Use <pinball-plunger label="Send"></pinball-plunger>. Listen for send; el.fire() does a full pull for you. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/plunger/README.md)
- [Stepper](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/stepper/stepper.js) (stepper, about 779 KB): A number stepper made of two pinball flippers either side of a two-digit score reel. Press a flipper and it snaps up, the lamp flashes and the drums roll to the new number, carrying into the tens like an old score counter. `<pinball-stepper>`: Use <pinball-stepper value="4" min="0" max="99"></pinball-stepper>. Read el.value; it fires input and change. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/stepper/README.md)
- [Drop targets](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/targets/targets.js) (checkboxes, about 838 KB): A row of up to four checkboxes as a bank of pinball drop targets with your labels printed on them. Tick one and a ball rolls in, knocks its target down and lights its lamp; untick it and the target springs back up. Knock all four down for a bonus chime. `<pinball-targets>`: Use <pinball-targets items="EMAIL,PUSH,TEXT,CALLS" checked="0,2"></pinball-targets>. Read el.selected (the ticked items) or el.checked (an array of booleans); it fires change and, when all are ticked, bonus. Works in forms with a name. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/targets/README.md)
- [Drain](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/drain/drain.js) (delete and undo, about 888 KB): A delete button with an undo window, built from a pinball outhole and a SHOOT AGAIN lamp. Press or drag the ball into the drain to delete; SHOOT AGAIN blinks while you can still undo, and pressing it kicks the ball back out. `<pinball-drain>`: Use <pinball-drain window="6000" label="Delete draft"></pinball-drain>. Listen for delete, undo and commit (the delete is final); el.reset() serves a new ball. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/drain/README.md)
- [Pop bumpers](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/bumper/bumper.js) (button, about 713 KB): Pinball pop bumpers as buttons. One file defines two: <pinball-bumper>, a single bumper you press like a clap or upvote button, and <pinball-bumpers>, a triangle of three that a ball ricochets around when you press it, scoring as it goes. `<pinball-bumper> and <pinball-bumpers>`: Use <pinball-bumper cap="+1"></pinball-bumper> for one button, or <pinball-bumpers caps="100,500,100"></pinball-bumpers> for the cluster. Both fire hit with { points, score, combo }. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/bumper/README.md)
- [Checkbox](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/checkbox/checkbox.js) (binary selection, about 5 KB): A single checkbox with a physical-style lamp and a recessed mechanical button. It exposes a boolean checked state and participates in forms. `<pinball-checkbox>`: Use <pinball-checkbox> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/checkbox/README.md)
- [Radio Group](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/radio-group/radio-group.js) (single-choice group, about 6 KB): A single-choice group rendered as a row of mechanical radio selectors. The selected value is reflected in the component property and optional form value. `<pinball-radio-group>`: Use <pinball-radio-group> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/radio-group/README.md)
- [Segmented Control](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/segmented/segmented.js) (compact single-choice selector, about 5 KB): A compact segmented selector for mutually exclusive values. One segment is visibly latched at a time, with a form value and change event. `<pinball-segmented>`: Use <pinball-segmented> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/segmented/README.md)
- [Progress](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/progress/progress.js) (progress indicator, about 5 KB): A determinate or indeterminate progress bar styled as a row of mechanical lane markings. It communicates task progress without being an input. `<pinball-progress>`: Use <pinball-progress> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/progress/README.md)
- [Meter](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/meter/meter.js) (scalar measurement, about 5 KB): A read-only scalar meter with a mechanical needle over low, middle and high zones. It exposes an accessible meter value and is not an input. `<pinball-meter>`: Use <pinball-meter> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/meter/README.md)
- [Rating](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/rating/rating.js) (rating input, about 6 KB): A star rating control where each star behaves like an illuminated target. It supports a configurable count, read-only presentation and form submission. `<pinball-rating>`: Use <pinball-rating> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/rating/README.md)
- [Tabs](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/tabs/tabs.js) (tab navigation, about 6 KB): A tab set with keyboard navigation and named content slots. Each tab selects one corresponding panel while preserving light-DOM content. `<pinball-tabs>`: Use <pinball-tabs> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/tabs/README.md)
- [Accordion](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/accordion/accordion.js) (expandable sections, about 6 KB): An accordion with up to eight expandable sections, optional multiple-open behavior and named slotted panel content. `<pinball-accordion>`: Use <pinball-accordion> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/accordion/README.md)
- [Disclosure](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/disclosure/disclosure.js) (single disclosure, about 5 KB): A simple disclosure built on the native details and summary elements. It exposes an open property and a composed toggle event. `<pinball-disclosure>`: Use <pinball-disclosure> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/disclosure/README.md)
- [Tooltip](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/tooltip/tooltip.js) (contextual hint, about 5 KB): A small contextual tooltip that appears on pointer hover or keyboard focus. The trigger content is provided through the default slot. `<pinball-tooltip>`: Use <pinball-tooltip> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/tooltip/README.md)
- [Dialog](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/dialog/dialog.js) (modal dialog, about 5 KB): A modal dialog that uses the native HTML dialog element, a trigger button and a close action. Title and body content remain in light DOM slots. `<pinball-dialog>`: Use <pinball-dialog> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/dialog/README.md)
- [Toast](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/toast/toast.js) (notification feedback, about 5 KB): A dismissible notification with a status announcement, severity variant and optional automatic timeout. `<pinball-toast>`: Use <pinball-toast> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/toast/README.md)
- [Breadcrumbs](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/breadcrumbs/breadcrumbs.js) (navigation trail, about 5 KB): A responsive breadcrumb navigation trail generated from a compact label and URL list. The final item is marked as the current page. `<pinball-breadcrumbs>`: Use <pinball-breadcrumbs> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/breadcrumbs/README.md)
- [Pagination](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/pagination/pagination.js) (page navigation, about 5 KB): A compact pagination control with previous/next actions, current-page state and a limited set of nearby page numbers. `<pinball-pagination>`: Use <pinball-pagination> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/pagination/README.md)
- [Search](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/search/search.js) (search input, about 5 KB): A compact search field with a dedicated submit action. It emits live query updates and a search event when submitted. `<pinball-search>`: Use <pinball-search> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/search/README.md)
- [Text Field](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/text-field/text-field.js) (single-line text input, about 5 KB): A single-line text input with label, placeholder, required state and form-associated value synchronization. `<pinball-text-field>`: Use <pinball-text-field> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/text-field/README.md)
- [Text Area](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/text-area/text-area.js) (multi-line text input, about 5 KB): A multi-line text input with resizable height, optional maximum length and form-associated value synchronization. `<pinball-text-area>`: Use <pinball-text-area> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/text-area/README.md)
- [Select](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/select/select.js) (single-choice dropdown, about 5 KB): A native select control in a custom pinball-styled panel. Options are configured from compact value:label pairs and the selected value can participate in a form. `<pinball-select>`: Use <pinball-select> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/select/README.md)
- [Combobox](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/combobox/combobox.js) (editable choice, about 7 KB): An editable combobox with text filtering, a listbox of matching options, keyboard selection and form-associated string value. `<pinball-combobox>`: Use <pinball-combobox> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/combobox/README.md)
- [File Drop](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/file-drop/file-drop.js) (file selection and dropzone, about 5 KB): A keyboard-accessible file chooser and drag-and-drop target. It reports selected File objects to application code but does not upload them. `<pinball-file-drop>`: Use <pinball-file-drop> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/file-drop/README.md)
- [Date Picker](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/date-picker/date-picker.js) (date input, about 5 KB): A date field that delegates parsing, calendar presentation and constraints to the browser’s native date input. `<pinball-date-picker>`: Use <pinball-date-picker> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/date-picker/README.md)
- [Color Picker](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/color-picker/color-picker.js) (color input, about 5 KB): A color picker using the native browser color input, with a synchronized uppercase hex value display and form support. `<pinball-color-picker>`: Use <pinball-color-picker> and read its documented properties or events. [Docs](https://github.com/Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/blob/main/color-picker/README.md)

Install any one with the shadcn CLI: `npx shadcn add Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui/NAME`, where NAME is toggle, slider, plunger, stepper, targets, drain, bumper, checkbox, radio-group, segmented, progress, meter, rating, tabs, accordion, disclosure, tooltip, dialog, toast, breadcrumbs, pagination, search, text-field, text-area, select, combobox, file-drop, date-picker, color-picker. The file lands in `public/pinball-ui/`.

Follow each component README for its supported attributes, properties, events, styling and form behavior. The original mechanical controls use --pb-size and --pb-page, and their sound can be muted with silent or PinballKit.sound = false. Form-associated utility controls use ElementInternals where browser support permits.

## The skill

- [pinball-ui skill](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/skills/pinball-ui/SKILL.md): the workflow and rules these were made by. Install with `npx skills add Brajesh31/pinmotion-ui`.
- [core.js](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/skills/pinball-ui/core.js): the shared core (the clock, the custom-element base, one WebGL context, the chrome ball's shader, the sounds).
- [starter.html](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/skills/pinball-ui/starter.html): the smallest whole example, a ball in a lane drawn without photographs.
- [look.mjs](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/skills/pinball-ui/look.mjs): photographs a page at chosen moments after an action and saves the frames side by side.

## How it was made

- [making-of/README.md](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/making-of/README.md): the directions that were dropped, how the plates were made and lined up, how the ball is drawn, and where the sounds came from.
- [making-of/prompts.md](https://brajesh31.github.io/pinmotion-ui/making-of/prompts.md): every image and sound prompt and setting.
